RecognizeAdvanced.description_en: Supports accurate detection of multi-format layouts, complex document backgrounds, and varying lighting environments. It enables detection after seal removal and supports advanced features such as low-confidence filtering and pattern Detection
RecognizeAdvanced.description_zh: 支持多格式版面、复杂文档背景和光照环境的精准识别，可实现印章擦除后识别，支持低置信度过滤、图案检测等高阶功能

RecognizeAirItinerary.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of fields including passenger name, ID card number, electronic ticket number, issue date, and issuing agency
RecognizeAirItinerary.description_zh: 支持包括旅客姓名、身份证号码、电子客票号码、填开日期、填开单位等字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeAllText.description_en: The OCR Unified Recognition API recognizes multiple image types, such as general text, ID cards, and invoices. Specify the image type using the Type parameter. You do not need to switch APIs
RecognizeAllText.description_zh: OCR统一识别接口支持识别多种图片类型，包括通用文字、个人卡证、发票等。您只需要通过Type参数指定图片类型，无须更换接口

RecognizeBankAcceptance.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields, such as issue date, draft number, issuer information, payee information, acceptor information, and draft amount
RecognizeBankAcceptance.description_zh: 支持包括出票日期、票据号码、出票人信息、收票人信息、承兑人信息、票据金额等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeBankAccountLicense.description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key information from a bank account opening permit, such as the account number, legal representative, issuing bank, approval number, company name, and permit number
RecognizeBankAccountLicense.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别银行开户许可证中的账号、法定代表人、开户银行、核准号、企业名称、编号等关键信息

RecognizeBankCard.description_en: It can accurately detect the bank card number and validity period on various types of bank cards. It supports recognition and extraction from both horizontal and vertical cards, as well as cards tilted at any angle. It covers most banks in the Chinese mainland and supports cards with varying digit lengths, embossed surfaces, flat surfaces, and other formats
RecognizeBankCard.description_zh: 可精准识别各类银行卡中的银行卡卡号和有效期，且支持横卡、竖卡及银行卡任意角度偏斜情况的识别与提取，支持中国内地大多数银行，以及各种位数、凸字卡面、平面卡面等的识别

RecognizeBasic.description_en: Quick and accurate character detection in images from online scenarios such as E-commerce product promotional images, community forum images, and user-generated content (UGC) images
RecognizeBasic.description_zh: 针对电商商品宣传图片、社区贴吧图片、网络UGC图片等网络场景下图片字符快速精准识别

RecognizeBirthCertification.description_en: It can accurately detect key information on birth certificates, such as date of birth, birth weight, and place of birth
RecognizeBirthCertification.description_zh: 可准确识别出生证明中的各项关键信息，包括出生日期、出生体重、出生地点等

RecognizeBusShipTicket.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as title, invoice number, departure station, arrival station, date, and amount.
RecognizeBusShipTicket.description_zh: 支持包括标题、发票号码、出发车站、到达车站、日期、金额等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeBusinessLicense.description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key fields from enterprise business licenses, including the Unified Social Credit Code, company name, address, entity type, legal representative, registered capital, organizational form, incorporation date, business term, and business scope. It supports business licenses, private non-enterprise registration certificates, social organization legal person registration certificates, and public institution legal person certificates
RecognizeBusinessLicense.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别企业营业执照中的统一社会信用代码、公司名称、地址、主体类型、法定代表人、注册资金、组成形式、成立日期、营业期限和经营范围等关键有效字段。支持营业执照、民办非企业登记证书、社会团体法人登记证书、事业单位法人证书

RecognizeCarInvoice.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields including invoice code, invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, VAT tax amount, certificate number, purchaser name, and purchaser ID number/code
RecognizeCarInvoice.description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、开票号码、开票日期、发票金额、增值税税额、合格证号、购买方名称、购买方身份证号/代码等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeCarNumber.description_en: Effectively detects vehicle license plate information. Support includes motor vehicle license plates, motorcycle license plates, and temporary license plates.
RecognizeCarNumber.description_zh: 可有效识别车辆车牌信息，支持机动车车牌、摩托车车牌以及临时车牌

RecognizeCarVinCode.description_en: Supports detection of vehicle VIN codes.

RecognizeChinesePassport.description_en: Supports structured content detection and recognition for passports of the People's Republic of China, including passports from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China). Detected fields include place of birth, date of birth, nationality, gender, passport number, validity period end date, issuing country, issuing location, and more
RecognizeChinesePassport.description_zh: 支持中国人民共和国护照的结构化内容检测识别功能，支持中国内地、中国香港、中国澳门和中国台湾地区的护照识别，识别内容包括出生地、出生日期、国籍、性别、护照号码、有效期至、签发国、签发地等字段

RecognizeCommonPrintedInvoice.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields, such as invoice code, invoice number, seller name, seller tax identification number, purchaser name, purchaser tax identification number, and total amount
RecognizeCommonPrintedInvoice.description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、发票号码、销售方名称、销售方识别号、购买方名称、购买方识别号、合计金额等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeCosmeticProduceLicense.description_en: Supports detection of key fields, including certificate name, enterprise name, unified social credit code, address, legal representative, license number, and more
RecognizeCosmeticProduceLicense.description_zh: 支持关键字段识别，包括证照名称、企业名称、社会信用代码、住址、法定代表人、许可证编号等

RecognizeCovidTestReport.description_en: Supports structured output of six key fields—name, certificate number, sampling date, sampling time, testing organization, and test result—from COVID-19 Testing Station records with varying formats across different regions nationwide
RecognizeCovidTestReport.description_zh: 支持对全国各地区不同版式的核酸检测记录中姓名、证件号码、采样日期、采样时间、检测机构、检测结果等6个关键字段的结构化结果输出

RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense.description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key fields on the ICP filing credential for Class II medical device business operations, including the filing number, company name, registered address, business premises, warehouse address, business model, legal representative, enterprise owner, business scope, license validity period, and filing date
RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别第二类医疗器械经营备案凭证所包含备案编号、企业名称、住所、经营场所、库房地址、经营方式、法定代表人、企业负责人、经营范围、许可期限、备案日期等关键字段信息

RecognizeDocumentStructure.description_en: Structurally detects document information and provides layout information output from two perspectives: element tiling and hierarchical tree. It can extract textual elements (such as individual characters, text blocks, lines, etc.) and corresponding layout formats (such as titles, paragraphs, tables) from documents and output them in sequence.
RecognizeDocumentStructure.description_zh: 对文档信息进行结构化识别，并提供元素平铺和层级树两种视角的版面信息输出。能够将文档中的文字元素（单字、文字块、行等）和相应的版面格式（标题、段落、表格）抽离并按顺序输出

RecognizeDrivingLicense.description_en: Supports structured extraction of fields such as name, license number, nationality, address, initial issue date, approved vehicle type, and validity period from a driver's license
RecognizeDrivingLicense.description_zh: 支持对驾驶证上的姓名、证号、国籍、住址、初次领证日期、准驾类型、有效期等字段进行结构化提取

RecognizeEduFormula.description_en: Supports detection of printed mathematical formulas.
RecognizeEduFormula.description_zh: 支持印刷体的数学公式识别

RecognizeEduOralCalculation.description_en: It can detect elementary school arithmetic problems and provide judgment results. It supports basic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) on integers, mixed integer operations, comparisons of magnitude, identification of the maximum or minimum number, and more
RecognizeEduOralCalculation.description_zh: 可以识别小学数学口算题目并给出题目判断结果。可支持整数的加减乘除四则运算、整数的混合运算、大小比较、最大数最小数等

RecognizeEduPaperCut.description_en: Supports structured electronic entry of supplementary exam papers across various subjects, automatically chunking questions and applying structured labeling to produce structured output for corresponding questions, stems, options, answers, and other content
RecognizeEduPaperCut.description_zh: 支持各学科的教辅试卷的结构化电子录入，将试卷中的题目进行自动化切分和结构化打标，并进行对应题目、题干、选项、答案等内容的结构化输出

RecognizeEduPaperOcr.description_en: Supports full-page OCR for K12 multi-subject scanning scenarios. The API supports OCR detection of printed text and formulas, returns their coordinates, and also detects the positions of accompanying figures in questions, returning their coordinate locations
RecognizeEduPaperOcr.description_zh: 支持K12全学科扫描场景的整页内容文字识别。接口支持印刷体文本及公式的OCR识别和坐标返回，此外，接口还可对题目中的配图位置进行检测并返回坐标位置

RecognizeEduPaperStructed.description_en: Support structured detection of multi-subject teaching aid test papers, automatically splitting questions from entire pages of workbooks, test papers, or teaching aids, and detecting the text content and coordinate positions within them
RecognizeEduPaperStructed.description_zh: 支持多学科教辅试卷的结构化识别，将整页练习册、试卷或教辅中的题目进行自动切题，并识别出其中的文字内容和坐标位置

RecognizeEduQuestionOcr.description_en: It can effectively detect questions. By tagging elements within the questions, the detection performance is enhanced
RecognizeEduQuestionOcr.description_zh: 可对题目进行有效识别。通过对题目的元素进行打标，提升题目的识别效果

RecognizeEnglish.description_en: Designed for efficiently detecting and recognizing printed English characters in fully English image-based documents, this solution provides English-specific recognition and English tokenization features, and supports basic functionalities such as rotation handling, table detection, and text coordinate extraction
RecognizeEnglish.description_zh: 针对全英文图片文档场景下英文印刷体字符高效检测和识别，具备英文专项识别和英文分词功能，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能

RecognizeEstateCertification.description_en: Accurately detects key information from real estate certificates, including owner details, property address, area size, land rights type, and more. It supports recognition of various property certificates issued across different regions in China
RecognizeEstateCertification.description_zh: 可准确识别不动产证中的各项关键信息，包括户主信息、房屋地址、面积大小、土地权利类型等，适用于全国各地的不同房产证识别

RecognizeExitEntryPermitToHK.description_en: Supports accurate detection of key fields in travel permits, such as name, date of birth, and certificate number.
RecognizeExitEntryPermitToHK.description_zh: 支持通行证中的各项关键信息，姓名、出生日期、证件号码等字段的准确识别

RecognizeExitEntryPermitToMainland.description_en: Accurately detects key information from travel permits, including name, date of birth, certificate number, and more. Supports Mainland Travel Permits for Hong Kong and Macao Residents as well as Mainland Travel Permits for Taiwan Residents
RecognizeExitEntryPermitToMainland.description_zh: 可准确识别通行证中的各项关键信息，包括姓名、出生日期、证件号码等。包括港澳居民来往大陆通行证以及台湾居民来往大陆通行证

RecognizeFoodManageLicense.description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key field information from a Food Operation License, including the producer name, unified social credit code, legal representative name, address, production site, food category, validity period, license number, and more
RecognizeFoodManageLicense.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别食品经营许可证所包含生产者名称、社会信用代码、法定代表人姓名、地址、生产场所、食品类别、有效期、许可证编号等关键字段信息

RecognizeFoodProduceLicense.description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key field information contained in a food production license, such as the operator name, unified social credit code, legal representative name, address, business premises, business scope, validity period, and license number
RecognizeFoodProduceLicense.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别食品生产许可证所包含经营者名称、社会信用代码、法定代表人姓名、地址、经营场所、经营项目、有效期、许可证编号等关键字段信息

RecognizeGeneral.description_en: Suitable for unstructured text recognition. Supports returning both the recognized text content and its position coordinates.
RecognizeGeneral.description_zh: 适用于非结构化文字识别，支持返回文字内容和位置坐标信息

RecognizeGeneralStructure.description_en: The general ticket extraction feature combines the capabilities of ReadLight OCR and the Qwen large language model (LLM) to extract key key-value (KV) information from long-tail receipts not supported by OCR, such as structured recognition and output of critical fields including Name, Address, and Date
RecognizeGeneralStructure.description_zh: 通用票证抽取结合读光OCR和通义千问大模型的能力，针对OCR不支持的长尾票据，提供关键KV信息抽取，例如名称、地址、开票日期等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeHKIdcard.description_en: This API recognizes both Hong Kong Permanent Identity Cards and Hong Kong Identity Cards, detecting all card fields such as the Chinese name (if available), English name, Chinese commercial code (if available), date of birth, sex, symbols, and identity card number
RecognizeHKIdcard.description_zh: 支持香港永久性居民身份证和香港居民身份证两种类型的证件识别，已支持全字段识别，包括中文姓名（如有）、英文姓名、中文姓名电码（如有）、出生日期、性别、符号标记、身份证号码等

RecognizeHandwriting.description_en: Supports handwriting recognition in complex scenarios, including Chinese handwriting, English handwriting, and numeric handwriting
RecognizeHandwriting.description_zh: 支持中文手写体、英文手写体、数字手写体等各种复杂场景的手写文字识别

RecognizeHealthCode.description_en: Supports health codes from major provinces and cities across China, and outputs classification results for key fields in health code images, such as name, date, time, color, and remarks
RecognizeHealthCode.description_zh: 包括全国主要省市健康码，支持健康码图片的姓名、日期、时间、颜色、备注信息等主要字段的识别结果输出

RecognizeHotelConsume.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as room number, check-in date, departure date, total consumption, total payment, and detailed consumption list
RecognizeHotelConsume.description_zh: 支持包括房号、入住日期、离店日期、消费总计、付款总计、消费详单等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeHousehold.description_en: It can structurally recognize the content of both the household registration page for permanent residents and the household head page, effectively extracting relevant household registration information from the household register
RecognizeHousehold.description_zh: 可结构化识别户口常住人口登记卡页面及户主页的内容，有效识别户口本上的相关户籍证明信息

RecognizeIdcard.description_en: This API recognizes structured fields from both the front and back of a second-generation Chinese resident identity card. These fields include name, gender, ethnicity, address, date of birth, ID number, issuing authority, and validity period. It also supports ID quality checks, such as detecting screen captures, photocopies, completeness scores, overall quality scores, tampering indexes, and face location detection
RecognizeIdcard.description_zh: 支持二代身份证正反面，包括姓名、性别、民族、地址、出生日期、身份证号、签发机关、有效期限等字段的结构化识别。支持身份证质量检测，是否翻拍，是否是复印件，完整度评分，整体质量分数、篡改指数及人脸位置检测

RecognizeInternationalBusinessLicense.description_en: This operation recognizes South Korean and Indian business licenses. It extracts key fields such as certificate type, company name, registration number, legal representative’s name, and issue date
RecognizeInternationalBusinessLicense.description_zh: 支持韩国、印度营业执照类型，提供包括证件类型、公司名称、注册号、法人姓名、签发日期等关键字段的识别能力

RecognizeInternationalIdcard.description_en: It can perform structured recognition of foreign identity documents. Currently supported documents include resident ID cards from Vietnam, South Korea, India, and Bangladesh. Recognizable fields include name, date of birth, document number, and more
RecognizeInternationalIdcard.description_zh: 可对国外身份证件进行结构化识别，目前支持越南、韩国、印度、孟加拉居民身份证，可识别字段包括姓名、出生日期、证件号码等

RecognizeInvoice.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields from VAT special invoices, VAT general invoices, and VAT electronic invoices, including invoice code, invoice number, invoicing date, invoice amount, tax amount, verification code, purchaser's tax ID, seller's tax ID, and invoice details
RecognizeInvoice.description_zh: 支持增值税专用发票、增值税普通发票、增值税电子发票识别，支持包括发票代码、发票号码、开票日期、发票金额、发票税额、检验码、购买方税号、销售方税号、发票详情等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeJanpanese.description_en: For scenarios involving fully Japanese-language image documents, this feature provides efficient Detection and recognition of printed Japanese text, and supports multiple Basic Features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
RecognizeJanpanese.description_zh: 针对全日文图片文档场景下日文印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能

RecognizeKorean.description_en: Efficiently detects and recognizes Korean printed text in Korean image document scenarios, and supports multiple basic features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
RecognizeKorean.description_zh: 针对韩语图片文档场景下韩文印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能

RecognizeLatin.description_en: Efficient detection and recognition of printed text in image documents for Latin-script scenarios, supporting multiple basic features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
RecognizeLatin.description_zh: 针对拉丁语系的图片文档场景下印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能

RecognizeMedicalDeviceManageLicense.description_en: Quickly and accurately detects key field information from a Medical Device Business License, including license number, company name, registered address, legal representative, enterprise owner, quality manager, warehouse address, business scope, validity period, and issuance date
RecognizeMedicalDeviceManageLicense.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别医疗器械经营许可证所包含许可证编号、企业名称、注册地址、法定代表人、企业负责人、质量管理人、仓库地址、经营范围、许可期限、发证日期等关键字段信息

RecognizeMedicalDeviceProduceLicense.description_en: Quickly and accurately detects key field information contained in medical device manufacturing licenses, such as license number, legal representative, company name, registered address, production address, production scope, responsible person, and validity period
RecognizeMedicalDeviceProduceLicense.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别医疗器械生产许可证所包含许可证编号、法定代表人、企业名称、注册地址、生产地址、生产范围、企业负责人、有效期限等关键字段信息

RecognizeMixedInvoices.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice code, total amount including tax, total amount, purchaser identification number, and invoice date for various types of receipts
RecognizeMixedInvoices.description_zh: 支持各类票据的发票代码、价税合计、合计金额、购买方识别号、开票日期等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeMultiLanguage.description_en: Supports automatic language categorization for major international language families and returns the corresponding textual information in the detected language
RecognizeMultiLanguage.description_zh: 支持国际主流几大语系的自动语言分类判定并返回对应语言的文字信息

RecognizeNonTaxInvoice.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice code, payer name, invoice number, total amount, and payee name
RecognizeNonTaxInvoice.description_zh: 支持包括票据代码、交款人、票据号码、合计金额、收款单位等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizePassport.description_en: Provides passport recognition services for major countries and regions worldwide, including the United States, France, the United Kingdom, Japan, and South Korea. Supported fields include nationality, passport number, date of birth, name, and more
RecognizePassport.description_zh: 可对美国、法国、英国、日本、韩国等世界多个主要国家和地区护照提供识别服务，支持字段包括国籍、护照号码、出生日期、姓名等

RecognizePaymentRecord.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as recipient name, total amount, payment method, product description, and payment time
RecognizePaymentRecord.description_zh: 支持包括收款方名称、合计金额、付款方式、商品说明、支付时间等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizePurchaseRecord.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields, such as order number, delivery information, transaction amount, store name, and detailed product list.
RecognizePurchaseRecord.description_zh: 支持包括订单编号、收货信息、交易金额、店铺名称、商品详单等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeQuotaInvoice.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice number, invoice code, and invoice amount
RecognizeQuotaInvoice.description_zh: 支持包括发票号码、发票代码、发票金额等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeRideHailingItinerary.description_en: Supports detection of all fields in ride-hailing trip receipts, including: service provider, applied on, start time, end time, rider's phone number, total amount, and other fields.
RecognizeRideHailingItinerary.description_zh: 支持网约车行程单全部字段的识别，包括：服务商、申请日期、行程开始时间、行程结束时间、行程人手机号、总金额等字段

RecognizeRollTicket.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields on roll invoices, including invoice code, invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, check code, amount in uppercase, seller's tax ID, and purchaser's tax ID
RecognizeRollTicket.description_zh: 支持对卷票上包括发票代码、发票号码、开票日期、发票金额、校验码、大写金额、销售方税号、购买方税号等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeRussian.description_en: Provides efficient Detection and recognition of Russian printed text in Image document scenarios, with Support for multiple Basic Features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
RecognizeRussian.description_zh: 针对图片文档场景下俄文印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能

RecognizeShoppingReceipt.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as the invoice issuer name, invoice date, contact number, address, and total (actual payment) amount
RecognizeShoppingReceipt.description_zh: 支持包括开票方名称、开票日期、联系电话、地址、合计（实际）金额等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeSocialSecurityCard.description_en: Supports recognition of all fields, including title, name, social security number, social security card number, bank account, issue date, and more
RecognizeSocialSecurityCard.description_zh: 支持全字段识别，包括标题、姓名、社会保障号码、社会保障卡号、银行账号、发卡日期等

RecognizeSocialSecurityCardVersionII.description_en: Supports full-field detection, including title, name, Social Security number, Social Security card number, bank account, issue date, and more
RecognizeSocialSecurityCardVersionII.description_zh: 支持全字段识别，包括标题、姓名、社会保障号码、社会保障卡号、银行账号、发卡日期等

RecognizeTableOcr.description_en: Supports effective detection of wired tables, striped tables, and wireless tables.
RecognizeTableOcr.description_zh: 支持对有线表格、条纹表格、无线表格进行有效识别

RecognizeTaxClearanceCertificate.description_en: Supports structured recognition outputs of key fields, including tax authority, taxpayer identification number, taxpayer name, total amount, ticket issuer, and tax clearance details
RecognizeTaxClearanceCertificate.description_zh: 支持包括税务机关、纳税人识别号、纳税人名称、合计金额、填票人、完税详单等关键字段的结构化识别输出

RecognizeTaxiInvoice.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice code, invoice number, date, and invoice amount
RecognizeTaxiInvoice.description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、发票号码、日期、发票金额等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeThai.description_en: Efficient Detection and recognition of Thai printed text in Thai image document scenarios, with support for multiple basic features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
RecognizeThai.description_zh: 针对泰语图片文档场景下泰文印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能

RecognizeTollInvoice.description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice code, invoice number, amount, date, vehicle type, exit, and entrance
RecognizeTollInvoice.description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、发票号码、金额、日期、车型、出口、入口等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeTradeMarkCertification.description_en: Quickly and accurately detects key fields in a trademark registration certificate, such as the trademark name, registrant, registrant address, validity period, and approved Data Service Project
RecognizeTradeMarkCertification.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别商标注册证中所包含的商标名称、注册人、注册人地址以及有效期限、核定服务项目等关键有效字段信息

RecognizeTrainInvoice.description_en:
Supports structured recognition and output of fields such as ticket number, departure station, arrival station, departure time, fare, seat type, passenger information, seat number, and train number.  
After the update on 2024-12-31, electronic train tickets are supported, and the following new fields are added to the response: electronic ticket number, buyer name, buyer unified credit code, title, invoice date, and remarks
RecognizeTrainInvoice.description_zh:
支持包括票号、出发站、到达站、开车时间、票价、座位类型、旅客信息、座位号、车次等字段结构化识别输出。
2024.12.31更新后，支持电子火车票，增加返回以下新字段：电子客票号、购买方名称、购买方统一信用代码、标题、开票日期、备注

RecognizeUsedCarInvoice.description_en: Recognizes key fields from used car unified sales invoices, including invoice code, invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, purchaser name, and purchaser ID number, and returns structured output
RecognizeUsedCarInvoice.description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、发票号码、开票日期、发票金额、购买方名称、购买方身份证号等关键字段结构化识别输出

RecognizeVehicleCertification.description_en: Supports structured extraction of fields such as vehicle model, Vehicle Identification Number (VIN), chassis model, and engine model
RecognizeVehicleCertification.description_zh: 支持车辆型号、车辆识别代号、底盘型号、发动机型号等字段进行结构化提取

RecognizeVehicleLicense.description_en: Supports automatic localization and recognition of key fields on both the front and back pages of a vehicle registration certificate. It also supports automatic segmentation and structured recognition when both pages appear in the same image
RecognizeVehicleLicense.description_zh: 支持对行驶证正页、副页关键字段的自动定位和识别，同时也支持对正副页在同一张图片的场景进行自动分割与结构化识别

RecognizeVehicleRegistration.description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key field information from a motor vehicle registration certificate, including certificate category, barcode, registration authority, registration date, motor vehicle registration number, and more
RecognizeVehicleRegistration.description_zh: 可快速精准的识别机动车注册证所包含证件类别、条形编码、登记机关、登记日期、机动车登记编号等关键字段信息

RecognizeWaybill.description_en: Supports detecting all key fields on the waybill.
RecognizeWaybill.description_zh: 支持识别面单上所有关键字段

VerifyBusinessLicense.description_en: The business license verification service checks for consistency across three key elements: the Unified Social Credit Code (or business registration number), the company name, and the legal representative's name
VerifyBusinessLicense.description_zh: 营业执照三要素核验支持通过输入营业执照的统一信用社会代码（工商注册号）、企业名称、法人姓名做一致性验证

VerifyVATInvoice.description_en: The VAT invoice verification API supports multiple invoice types, such as VAT special invoices, VAT ordinary invoices (folded), VAT ordinary invoices (roll), electronic VAT ordinary invoices (including electronic VAT ordinary invoices for expressway toll fees), unified motor vehicle sales invoices, and unified second-hand vehicle sales invoices. You can enter key invoice fields to retrieve the actual invoice details, including invoice type, invoice code, invoice number, cancellation flag, issue date, buyer’s tax ID, and other invoice information. You can verify invoices issued on the same day (T+0). Note: Verification may be delayed by several hours to over ten hours
VerifyVATInvoice.description_zh: 发票核验接口支持包括：增值税专用发票、增值税普通发票（折叠票）、增值税普通发票（卷票）、增值税电子普通发票（含收费公路通行费增值税电子普通发票）、机动车销售统一发票、二手车销售统一发票多种类型发票核验。您可以通过输入发票的关键验证字段，返回真实的票面信息，包括发票类型、发票代码、发票号码、作废标志、开票日期、购方税号及其他发票信息等。当天开具发票当日可查验（T+0）。注意：可能有几小时到十几小时的延迟
